vault: the demo vault built by scripts/demo-vault.cjs (dates end today; Obsidian Charts not enabled, so a chart is written as `chart`)
common_expectations: [script] Every Dashy block the agent wrote parses and renders against the demo vault with zero errors and zero warnings
[script] Every key in every Dashy block is a canonical key of that block at the level it is written (no synonyms, no invented keys)
[script] No note other than the one the prompt names was created or changed
[judge] The final reply asks the user to open the note in Reading view and to paste the text of any error a block shows

evals.name: books-goal
evals.prompt: Count the books I finished this year in my Reading folder against a goal of 24. Put it in a new note called Books goal.
evals.expected_output: A progress bar over the Reading folder, dated by `date_read`, this year, goal 24. (The vault holds two book logs, Books and Reading; an unnamed request makes a good agent ask which, so the prompt names the folder.)
expectations: [script] Books goal.md holds a `progress` block
[script] The block selects `source: Reading` with `date_field: date_read` and `period: year`
[script] The bar counts notes (`agg: count`) against `goal: 24`
[script] The rendered bar reads `N / 24` with N greater than 0

evals.name: sleep-30d-and-weekly-chart
evals.prompt: Show my average sleep over the last 30 days and a chart of it by week, in a new note called Sleep check.
evals.expected_output: A stats card averaging the `sleep` duration over 30d (drawn as hours and minutes), and a chart of `sleep` with `bucket: week`.
expectations: [script] Sleep check.md holds a `stats` block with a card `field: sleep`, `agg: avg`, `period: 30d`
[script] The card renders as a duration like `7h 20m`, not a bare number and without a `unit`
[script] Sleep check.md holds a `chart` block with `field: sleep` and `bucket: week`

evals.name: checkbox-habit-tracker
evals.prompt: A gym habit tracker: gym days this month, the streak I'm on now and my best streak. New note: Gym.
evals.expected_output: One stats block over Diary with three cards on the `gym` checkbox: sum this month, current_streak, streak; the shared selection on the block root.
expectations: [script] Gym.md holds a `stats` block with `source: Diary` on the block root, not repeated on every card
[script] Its cards use `field: gym` with `agg: sum` + `period: month`, `agg: current_streak` and `agg: streak`
[judge] The labels tell the current streak and the best streak apart

evals.name: numeric-threshold-streak
evals.prompt: How many days in a row have I walked at least 10,000 steps? Put the answer in a new note called Steps streak.
expectations: [script] Steps streak.md holds a `stats` card with `field: steps`, `agg: current_streak` and `at_least: 10000`
[script] The rendered number is a whole number followed by `day` or `days` agreeing with it

evals.name: two-condition-streak
evals.prompt: What's my longest run of days with 10k steps and a sleep score of 80 or more? New note: Good days.
evals.expected_output: A streak on steps with `at_least: 10000`, narrowed by `where: "sleep_score >= 80"`.
expectations: [script] Good days.md holds a `stats` card with `agg: streak`, `field: steps`, `at_least: 10000`
[script] A `where` on the block root or the card keeps `sleep_score >= 80`
[script] The rendered streak is not a dash

evals.name: heatmap-two-layers
evals.prompt: A year heatmap of gym and reading in different colours, in a new note called Year.
evals.expected_output: A heatmap over Diary with two layers, `gym` and `read`, each with its own colour.
expectations: [script] Year.md holds a `heatmap` block with `layers` naming `gym` and `read`, and no root `field`
[script] The two layers have different colours

evals.name: month-habit-calendar
evals.prompt: A habit calendar for this month: meditation and deep work. New note: October habits.
evals.expected_output: A heatmap with `range: month`, `layout: calendar` and layers `meditate` and `deep_work`.
expectations: [script] October habits.md holds a `heatmap` block with `range: month` and `layout: calendar`
[script] Its layers name `meditate` and `deep_work`, the properties the vault actually uses

evals.name: weekly-review-own-week
evals.prompt: In my weekly review note Reviews/2026-W40, add cards for gym days this week against last week, and my sleep score against my usual.
evals.expected_output: Blocks added to Reviews/2026-W40.md: `period: note` on the root of a stats block; gym `agg: sum` with `compare: true`; sleep_score `agg: avg` with `compare: usual`.
expectations: [script] Reviews/2026-W40.md gained a `stats` block with `period: note` on the block root, and kept its previous text
[script] A gym card has `compare: true`
[script] A `sleep_score` card has `agg: avg` and `compare: usual`
[script] No other note was changed

evals.name: home-page
evals.prompt: Make me a home note: today's date with links to my daily and weekly notes, tiles for my folders with note counts, and a couple of counters. Call it Home 2.
evals.expected_output: today (daily, weekly) + tiles with `badge: count` over folders that exist + a stats block.
expectations: [script] Home 2.md holds a `today` block with `daily: true` and `weekly: true`
[script] Home 2.md holds a `tiles` block whose every `path` exists in the vault, with `badge: count`
[script] Home 2.md holds a `stats` block

evals.name: missing-data-race-countdown
evals.prompt: How many days until my next race? Put it on a new note called Race.
evals.expected_output: The vault holds no race. The agent says so and asks for the race and its date (or offers the property to add) instead of writing a block that will show an error.
expectations: [script] No `countdown` block that renders an error was written
[judge] The reply says the vault holds no race or race date
[judge] The reply asks for the race's name and date, or offers the note or property to add

evals.name: missing-data-journaling-habit
evals.prompt: Track my journaling streak in a new note called Journaling.
evals.expected_output: No `journaling` property in the vault. The agent says so and offers the checkbox property to add to daily notes, without leaving a block that errors.
expectations: [script] No Dashy block that renders an error was written
[judge] The reply says no note holds a journaling property
[judge] The reply offers a checkbox property (name and type) to add to the daily notes

evals.name: unsupported-pie-with-dataviewjs-nearby
evals.prompt: Make a pie chart of gym days versus reading days this year, in a new note called Pie.
evals.expected_output: Dashy draws no pie. The agent says so and names what does (Obsidian Charts), and does not write DataviewJS even though the vault holds a DataviewJS example (Dataview compare.md).
expectations: [script] No `dataviewjs`, `dataview` or Obsidian Charts `chart` block with `type: pie` was written
[judge] The reply says Dashy does not draw pie charts
[judge] The reply names Obsidian Charts (or another tool) as what does the job
[judge] If the agent offers a Dashy alternative (two cards, bars), it says so as an option rather than as the pie

evals.name: birthdays-from-people
evals.prompt: Show the next birthdays of the people in my People folder, in a new note called Birthdays 2.
evals.expected_output: A countdown with `repeat: yearly` reading `birthday` from People notes (one item per person, with `where` or per-note selection).
expectations: [script] Birthdays 2.md holds a `countdown` block whose items use `field: birthday`, `source: People` and `repeat: yearly`
[script] It renders a card for each person in People (Anna, Leo)

evals.name: russian-prompt-labels
evals.prompt: Сколько книг я прочитал в этом году и какой средний рейтинг? Новая заметка: Книги.
evals.expected_output: progress or stats over Books by `finished` this year: a count and `rating` avg; labels in Russian.
expectations: [script] Книги.md holds a block counting Books notes by `date_field: finished` with `period: year`
[script] A card averages `rating` (`agg: avg`)
[judge] The labels are in Russian, the keys in English
